name: Generating Explanations and Designing Solutions
short_description: Develop and intentionally communicate explanations and design solutions for scientific phenomena to different audiences.
definition: The ability to construct and communicate clear, evidence-based explanations of scientific phenomena tailored to different audiences. This includes translating complex scientific concepts into accessible language ("ELI5"), developing models to represent scientific processes, creating rigorous scientific explanations with appropriate terminology, and designing innovative solutions to scientific and engineering problems based on fundamental principles.
